SETTINGS

CONTROLS

Mobile: drag the lower-left area to move. Push fully forward to sprint, or tap SPRINT. Swipe the right side to look. Tap CROUCH to toggle. Tap OPEN / USE to interact; keep holding HOLD for chains and boards. FIRE, AIM, RELOAD and PACK are separate buttons. When grabbed, hold BREAK FREE. Tap the intro skip hint to begin playing immediately.

  • W A S D move
  • Shift run (loud)
  • Ctrl / C crouch (quiet)
  • Mouse look (if the browser blocks mouse capture, hold left button + drag)
  • E interact; hold to cut / pry
  • F light torch
  • Q throw glass (distraction)
  • LMB / RMB fire / aim weapon
  • R reload; 1 / 2 / 3 switch weapon
  • H holster; V inspect weapon
  • Tab survival pack; F3 performance overlay
  • Space struggle when grabbed
  • Esc pause
